messages:
deploybot: scheduling partitioned backfill 'tombstone_cleanup' on events.part_YYYYMM in change window 2025-05-10 03:00-04:30 UTC. approach: add tombstone_flag boolean (nullable), run chunked delete-to-null backfill, then compact. canary traffic 0.5%, service pin events/worker@v2.9.7. holdpoint at 03:30 UTC. automatic abort if deadlock_count > 2 in 5m or replica_lag > 15s for 3m. :warning:
jordan: ack. note we need to pin the background job runner image and the db client: `jobs/runner@v2.9.7`, `pgclient@2.4.0`. last rollout with pgclient@2.5 caused unexpected statement reordering.
nina: i'm on-call that window. i'll monitor deadlocks, lock_waits, and compaction throughput. recommend chunk_size=500 and inter_chunk_delay=250ms to smooth IO. if we spike, we can drop chunk_size to 100 immediately.
patrick: prefer to run FK checks asynchronously post-backfill. also plan to set feature flag `events.tombstone_cleanup_v2` default off, flip on only after canary success. release note snippet ready.
ci-bot: preflight CI checks: staging backfill trial passed (12m), migration runner image available, dashboards created (#dash-6281234567).
jordan: rollback plan: 1) pause backfill runner 2) revert pin to events/worker@v2.9.6 3) run safe-revert job to restore tombstone_flag=null for affected rows if corruption detected 4) schedule manual intervention for compaction. if holdpoint hit, exec steps 1-2 and open incident channel.
nina: add an emergency throttle endpoint: `POST /backfill/618/pause` and `/backfill/618/resume?chunk_size=100`. test those endpoints before window.
patrick: monitoring hooks: pg.blocking_pids, pg.deadlock_errors, replica_lag_seconds, events.worker.p99, backfill.rows_per_min. alert: deadlock_errors >1 for 2m or replica_lag >10s triggers paging.
jordan: preflight checklist added: - pin images pushed to registry - smoke backfill on small shard in staging - verify no long TRUNCATE/DDL locks on staging - confirm replica lag <3s across regions - test emergency pause endpoints
patrick: small mitigation if shard hot: reroute writes for that shard to write-fallback via router and run backfill at lower chunk_rate. script: `tools/reroute-writes.sh <shard> fallback`
deploybot: manual ops: `/deploy pin jobs/runner@v2.9.7` and `/deploy hold 6281234567 03:30`
nina: tagging @jordan @patrick as holdpoint leads. i'll update release notes and feature flag gating. :thumbsup:
deploybot: will post reminders T-45m, T-10m, and at holdpoint. will open ephemeral channel #deploy-6281234567 during window. good luck! :rocket:
